projects.title: Projects
projects.description: A project holds a brief and sources the assistant can search during meetings.
projects.empty: No projects yet. Create one and add the notes, files, and links the assistant should know.
projects.deleteConfirm: Delete this project, its sources, and its meetings?

brief.title: Brief
brief.description: Always sent to the assistant. Keep it short: what this project is, who is involved, what matters.

sources.title: Sources
sources.description: Indexed locally. The assistant searches these on its own when the conversation needs them.
sources.caption: Caption
sources.captionPlaceholder: Describe this image for the assistant

dialog.title: Add source
dialog.textPlaceholder: Paste notes, an agenda, anything useful

meetings.title: Meetings
meetings.description: Live transcript of your microphone. Start a meeting, speak, and lines appear here.
meetings.empty: No meetings yet. Start one from a project or with the button above.
meetings.deleteConfirm: Delete this meeting and its transcript?

context.title: Meeting context
context.description: Agenda or notes for this meeting only. Sent to the assistant alongside the project brief.

errors.control: Could not change the meeting state.

observer.toolsUnavailable: This provider does not support tools; the assistant answers from the transcript only.
observer.failing: The assistant has failed {{count}} times in a row. Check the provider settings.

readiness.disabled: The meeting assistant is off. Turn it on in Assistant.
readiness.no_provider: No AI provider is set. Choose one in Assistant.
readiness.unsupported_provider: {{detail}} cannot run the meeting assistant. Choose another provider in Assistant.
readiness.missing_api_key: No API key for {{detail}}. Add one in Assistant.
readiness.no_model: No model is selected for {{detail}}. Pick one in Assistant.

capture.systemAudioUnavailable: System audio is unavailable; transcribing your microphone only. {{message}}
capture.systemAudioHint: On macOS, allow Meet Assist under System Settings, Privacy & Security, Screen & System Audio Recording, then end and start the meeting again.

onboarding.subtitle: 请选择一个转录模型以开始使用

parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v2.name: Parakeet V2
parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v2.description: 仅支持英语。英语用户的最佳模型。

moonshine-base.name: Moonshine Base
moonshine-base.description: 非常快速，仅支持英语。口音处理良好。

moonshine-small-streaming-en.name: Moonshine V2 Small
moonshine-small-streaming-en.description: 快速，仅支持英语。速度与准确度的良好平衡。

breeze-asr.name: Breeze ASR
breeze-asr.description: 针对台湾国语优化。支持语码转换。

sense-voice-int8.name: SenseVoice
sense-voice-int8.description: 非常快速。支持中文、英语、日语、韩语、粤语。

gigaam-v3-e2e-ctc.name: GigaAM v3
gigaam-v3-e2e-ctc.description: 俄语语音识别。快速且准确。

canary-180m-flash.name: Canary 180M Flash
canary-180m-flash.description: 非常快速。支持英语、德语、西班牙语、法语。支持翻译。

canary-1b-v2.name: Canary 1B v2
canary-1b-v2.description: 准确的多语言模型。25种欧洲语言。支持翻译。

cohere-int8.name: Cohere
cohere-int8.description: 大型模型，速度较慢，但多语言识别非常准确。

assistant.title: Set up your assistant
assistant.description: The meeting assistant and summaries use an LLM provider. Pick one, add your API key if needed, and test the connection.
assistant.hint: You can change this later in Assistant.

capabilities.streaming: 在您说话时实时显示转录

shortcut.title: Shortcut
shortcut.description: Start or end a meeting from anywhere.

toggle_meeting.name: Meeting shortcut
toggle_meeting.description: Starts a meeting in your most recent project, or ends the running one.

errors.reset: 无法将快捷键重置为原始值

language.title: 语言
language.description: 选择语音识别的语言。自动将自动确定语言，选择特定语言可以提高该语言的准确度。

provider.title: AI provider
provider.description: The model Meet Assist uses for nudges, summaries, and image digests.

select.title: 提供商
select.description: 选择一个兼容 OpenAI 或 Anthropic 的提供商。

apiFormat.title: API 格式
apiFormat.description: 自定义端点期望的请求格式。

baseUrl.title: 基础 URL
baseUrl.description: 所选提供商的 API 基础 URL。仅自定义提供商可编辑。

apiKey.title: API 密钥
apiKey.description: 所选提供商的 API 密钥。

model.title: 模型
model.descriptionCustom: 提供自定义端点期望的模型标识符。
model.descriptionDefault: 选择所选提供商提供的模型。

models.title: 转录模型
models.description: 选择转录模型或下载其他模型。不同模型提供不同的准确度和速度。
models.deleteConfirm: 确定要删除 {{modelName}} 吗？您需要重新下载才能使用。
models.deleteActiveConfirm: {{modelName}} 是您当前使用的模型。删除后将停止转录，直到您选择新的模型。确定要删除吗？

filters.streaming: 筛选支持实时转录的模型
filters.translation: 筛选支持翻译为英语的模型

rescan.label: 重新扫描
rescan.tooltip: 重新扫描在 Meet Assist 之外添加到模型文件夹或 Hugging Face 缓存中的模型

models.noModelsMatch: 没有符合此筛选条件的模型。

microphone.title: 麦克风
microphone.description: 选择您偏好的麦克风设备

channel.title: 输入通道
channel.description: 选择要录制的输入通道。如果您的音频接口有多个输入，请使用此选项。

audioFeedback.label: 音频反馈
audioFeedback.description: 录制开始和停止时播放声音

outputDevice.title: 输出设备
outputDevice.description: 选择用于反馈声音的音频输出设备

experimentalToggle.label: 实验性功能
experimentalToggle.description: 启用仍在开发中的实验性功能。

transcribe.title: Whisper 加速
transcribe.description: Whisper 模型的硬件加速。自动模式在可用时使用 GPU（macOS 上使用 Metal，Windows/Linux 上使用 Vulkan）。

ort.title: ONNX 加速
ort.description: ONNX 模型的硬件加速（Parakeet、Canary、Moonshine 等）。Windows 上的 DirectML 为实验性功能。模型可能无法正常转录。

startHidden.label: 隐藏启动
startHidden.description: 启动到系统托盘而不打开窗口。

autostart.label: 开机启动
autostart.description: 登录计算机时自动启动 Meet Assist。

showTrayIcon.label: 显示托盘图标
showTrayIcon.description: 在系统托盘中显示 Meet Assist 图标。

translateToEnglish.label: 翻译为英语
translateToEnglish.description: 在转录过程中自动将其他语言的语音翻译为英语。

modelUnload.title: 卸载模型
modelUnload.description: 当模型在指定时间内未使用时自动释放 GPU/CPU 内存

customWords.title: 自定义词汇
customWords.description: 帮助受支持的模型识别名称和专业术语。目前，模糊纠错仅适用于使用 A–Z 字母和数字的词语。

voiceActivityDetection.title: 语音活动检测
voiceActivityDetection.description: 过滤录音中的静音。支持流式的模型会使用更长的 VAD 尾段；停用 VAD 则会录制原始音频。

vadBackend.title: 语音活动检测后端
vadBackend.description: 选择用于过滤静音的检测器。Earshot 为实验性功能；如果语音被截断或噪音被保留，请切换回 Silero。

fillerWordRemoval.title: 移除语气词
fillerWordRemoval.description: 从转录中移除常见的语气词。关闭此选项即可保留这些词。

chineseScript.title: 简繁转换
chineseScript.description: 将普通话和粤语转录输出为简体或繁体中文。其他语言不受影响。

liveLogs.title: 实时日志
liveLogs.description: 实时传输应用程序日志，无需打开日志文件即可诊断问题。仅显示此面板打开期间产生的日志；遵循上方的“日志级别”设置。
liveLogs.empty: 正在等待日志…… 应用产生日志时将显示在此处。

updateChecks.label: 检查更新
updateChecks.description: 自动检查 Meet Assist 的新版本

whatsNewPreview.title: 预览新功能
whatsNewPreview.description: 打开最新内置发行说明，且不标记为已查看

onboardingPreview.title: 预览新手引导
onboardingPreview.description: 预览新手引导界面，而不更改权限、模型或完成状态

soundTheme.label: 声音主题
soundTheme.description: 选择录制开始和停止反馈的声音主题

wordCorrectionThreshold.title: 词汇修正阈值
wordCorrectionThreshold.description: 自定义词汇修正的灵敏度

keyboardImplementation.title: 键盘实现
keyboardImplementation.description: 选择键盘快捷键的后端。
keyboardImplementation.bindingsReset: 键盘快捷键不兼容，已重置为默认值

whatsNewUpdates.label: 显示新功能
whatsNewUpdates.description: Meet Assist 更新后显示发行说明

appDataDirectory.title: 应用数据目录
appDataDirectory.description: Meet Assist 存储数据的位置

supportDevelopment.title: 支持开发
supportDevelopment.description: 帮助我们继续开发 Handy

ggml.title: ggml
ggml.description: OpenAI Whisper 自动语音识别模型的高性能推理
ggml.details: Meet Assist 使用 ggml 进行快速的本地语音转文字处理。感谢 Georgi Gerganov 和贡献者们的出色工作。

meeting.title: Meeting assistant
meeting.description: How the assistant watches live meetings.

enabled.label: Meeting assistant
enabled.description: When on, every {{interval}} seconds the recent transcript, your project brief and meeting context are sent to the chosen provider so the assistant can decide whether to speak up.

sensitivity.label: Sensitivity
sensitivity.description: How eager the assistant is to speak up.

interval.label: Check interval
interval.description: Seconds between checks of the live transcript.

beep.label: Beep on nudge
beep.description: Play a short sound when the assistant speaks up.

systemAudio.label: Capture system audio
systemAudio.description: Hear the other side of the call. Takes effect when the next meeting starts.

appLanguage.description: 更改 Meet Assist 界面的语言

theme.title: 应用主题
theme.description: 选择 Meet Assist 跟随系统主题，还是保持浅色或深色
